Extensive experiments on indoor and outdoor benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves strong open-vocabulary occupancy performance, validating the effectiveness and generality of our framework. Code will be available at https://github.com/JuIvyy/LegoOcc.
tldr: 提出LegoOcc++，在仅二值占据监督下实现一致的开词汇室内外3D占据预测。
motivation: 室内开词汇3D占据预测受密集遮挡、复杂几何和细粒度长尾语义影响，仍具挑战；同时为减少昂贵的体素级语义标注，本文研究仅需二值占据标签的几何监督设定。
method: 以Language-Embedded Gaussians作为耦合3D几何与语言对齐语义的统一表示；提出opacity-aware Poisson-based Gaussian-to-Occupancy公式，在二值占据监督下稳定聚合体积信息；通过渲染高斯特征并与冻结开词汇模型对齐，结合Progressive Temperature Decay减少splatting中的特征混合，并引入Instance-Level Semantic Consistency与Covisibility-Aware Support-View Selection提升语义一致性和多视角监督效率。
result: 在室内与室外基准上的大量实验表明该方法取得较强的开词汇占据性能，验证了框架的有效性与跨环境通用性；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: LegoOcc++贡献在于以语言嵌入高斯统一几何与语义，在几何-only二值监督下实现开词汇3D占据预测，并通过实例级一致性与共视感知视角选择缓解碎片化预测和冗余监督，且可扩展至室外驾驶场景。

title: Fovea-JEPA: Overcoming Geometric Blind Spots in V-JEPA for Camera Motion Recognition
abstract: Camera motion recognition requires separating viewpoint changes caused by camera translation, rotation, or zoom from object motion and scene dynamics. Video-language models often rely on semantic cues and struggle with the geometric evidence needed for this task. Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures such as V-JEPA offer strong spatio-temporal representations, but our experiments suggest that they underrepresent geometric cues in some regions. Under temporal-reversal supervision, V-JEPA improves overall but degrades on several motion families, whereas a weaker geometry-oriented VGGT predictor improves across all families. We refer to these geometrically underrepresented regions as geometric blind spots and propose Fovea-JEPA to identify and address them. Using V-JEPA as the base model and VGGT as a geometry expert, we construct intervention pseudo-labels from their prediction errors to weakly supervise a blind-spot predictor. The predictor produces token-wise response maps, which are aggregated into a clip-level intervention score to guide adaptive fusion of visual and geometric features. This selective intervention introduces complementary geometric information while preserving reliable visual predictions. Experiments on CameraMotionDataset, CameraBench, and ShotBench demonstrate the effectiveness of Fovea-JEPA, with gains of 9.67, 8.67, and 24.38 percentage points over previously reported state-of-the-art baselines, respectively. Code and models will be released upon acceptance.
tldr: 提出Fovea-JEPA定位并补偿V-JEPA的几何盲区，通过VGGT伪标签与自适应融合提升相机运动识别。
motivation: 相机运动识别需要将相机平移、旋转或缩放导致的视角变化与物体运动、场景动态区分开，而视频语言模型常依赖语义线索、缺乏几何证据。实验发现V-JEPA在部分区域对几何线索表征不足，形成几何盲区；时序反转监督虽提升整体性能，却在若干运动类别上退化，而几何导向的VGGT预测器在所有类别上均有提升。
method: 以V-JEPA为基座模型、VGGT为几何专家，利用二者预测误差构造干预伪标签，弱监督训练盲区预测器；该预测器输出token级响应图并聚合为片段级干预分数，指导视觉特征与几何特征的自适应融合，在保留可靠视觉预测的同时选择性引入互补几何信息。
result: 在CameraMotionDataset、CameraBench和ShotBench上分别较此前报道的最优基线提升9.67、8.67和24.38个百分点，验证了Fovea-JEPA的有效性。
conclusion: Fovea-JEPA通过识别并补偿V-JEPA的几何盲区，实现了视觉与几何信息的互补融合，为相机运动识别提供了新思路；代码与模型将在论文接收后发布。

title: Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Network for Single-Shot 3D Reconstruction from Fringe Patterns
abstract: Deep learning facilitates rapid single shot three dimensional (3D) reconstruction using fringe projection profilometry (FPP), but recovering accurate surface height from a single high frequency fringe image remains challenging because both long-range spatial consistency and fine geometric details must be preserved. Convolutional networks are limited in modeling long range dependencies, whereas window-based Transformers establish global interactions only progressively with increasing depth. To address these limitations, a hybrid Mamba Transformer network is proposed for fringe to height regression. The network adopts a Swin based U shaped architecture and introduces visual state space modeling at the intermediate resolution encoder stage. An axial and dilated vision state space (ADVSS) block is further developed to enhance prescan feature encoding through local, dilated, and axial depthwise convolutions while retaining four directional selective scanning. This design combines linear complexity long range modeling with direction aware preservation of local fringe structures. Experiments on a publicly available FPP dataset show that the proposed method outperforms hNet, SwinConvUNet, UHRNet, and HiDNet in mean absolute error(MAE), root mean square error (RMSE), absolute relative error, and structural similarity index measure (SSIM). Using only one deformed fringe image, the proposed method achieves an RMSE of 0.548 mm and an SSIM of 0.9985, reducing RMSE by 65.2% and 59.6% relative to UHRNet and HiDNet, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining selective state space modeling with hierarchical window based attention for accurate single-shot FPP reconstruction.
tldr: 提出混合Mamba-Transformer网络，从单幅条纹图实现高精度3D重建。
motivation: 单幅高频条纹图的FPP三维重建需同时保持长程空间一致性与精细几何细节；CNN难以建模长程依赖，而基于窗口的Transformer需随深度逐步建立全局交互。
method: 提出Swin式U形混合Mamba-Transformer网络进行条纹到高度回归，在中间分辨率编码阶段引入视觉状态空间建模；设计ADVSS模块，以局部、膨胀和轴向深度卷积增强预扫描特征编码，并保留四方向选择性扫描。
result: 在公开FPP数据集上，MAE、RMSE、绝对相对误差和SSIM均优于hNet、SwinConvUNet、UHRNet与HiDNet；仅用单幅变形条纹图取得RMSE 0.548 mm、SSIM 0.9985，较UHRNet和HiDNet分别降低RMSE 65.2%和59.6%。
conclusion: 结果表明，将选择性状态空间建模与分层窗口注意力结合，可有效提升单帧FPP重建精度，为高精度单Shot三维测量提供新路线。

title: RelateGS: Reliable Semantic and Relational Evidence for 3D Scene Understanding with Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Language-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has advanced language-driven 3D scene understanding by incorporating semantic and relational cues into reconstructed scenes. However, relation-aware grounding depends not only on representing such information, but also on whether the underlying scene-side evidence is reliable and sufficient. Multi-view semantic aggregation can incorporate weak observations, while object relations can remain under-observed along the available camera trajectory, leading to ambiguous evidence for target disambiguation. We present RelateGS, a structured language-aware Gaussian representation that selectively refines semantic and relational evidence for 3D visual grounding. RelateGS suppresses unreliable observations during semantic feature uplifting and consolidates multi-view object observations into a persistent 3D graph. The graph further identifies under-observed object relations and guides targeted re-querying of informative existing frames to complement their evidence. Experiments on Sr3D+ and Nr3D demonstrate competitive 3D grounding performance, improving the previous best by 7.9 and 1.7 percentage points at Acc@0.25, respectively.
tldr: RelateGS通过筛选不可靠语义观测并利用3D图补全欠观测关系，提升三维视觉定位可靠性。
motivation: 语言感知的三维高斯泼溅虽已引入语义与关系线索，但关系感知定位还依赖场景侧证据是否可靠充分。多视角语义聚合可能混入弱观测，且沿相机轨迹的对象关系可能观测不足，导致目标消歧证据模糊。
method: 提出RelateGS结构化语言感知高斯表示，在语义特征提升阶段抑制不可靠观测，并将多视角对象观测整合为持久3D图。该图进一步识别欠观测的对象关系，并引导对已有信息帧进行定向重查询以补全关系证据。
result: 在Sr3D+和Nr3D上取得有竞争力的三维定位性能，Acc@0.25分别较此前最佳方法提升7.9和1.7个百分点。
conclusion: RelateGS通过选择性精炼语义与关系证据，并利用3D图引导帧重查询，提高了关系感知三维视觉定位的可靠性；其证据补全思路对语言驱动三维场景理解具有潜在影响。

title: FreeView: Robust 3D Reconstruction from Uncurated Views
abstract: Reconstructing a coherent 3D scene from uncurated image collections remains challenging due to the presence of irrelevant or non-overlapping views. Recent work has shown that feed-forward reconstruction models contain internal view-consistency signals that support distractor rejection. However, reference-conditioned filtering relies on a curated clean reference, which is not guaranteed in practical image collections. To address this limitation, we introduce FreeView, a training-free framework that jointly selects a filtering reference and rejects distractor views from an uncurated collection. FreeView leverages collection-level consensus to identify a representative view that serves as a reliable reference for filtering. It then adapts view rejection to each input collection by combining complementary visual and geometric evidence. This approach preserves useful views under substantial appearance and viewpoint variations while rejecting distractors. FreeView integrates with both VGGT and pi^3, removing the need for a manually curated reference or manual calibration of view rejection. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate high clean-view retention and distractor rejection rates, leading to reliable 3D reconstruction from uncurated views.
tldr: FreeView 无需训练，可从未筛选图像中联合选择参考视图并剔除干扰视图，实现鲁棒三维重建。
motivation: 从未筛选图像集合重建一致三维场景时，无关或非重叠视图会严重干扰；现有前馈重建模型虽含视图一致性信号，但依赖人工精选的干净参考视图，实际场景难以保证。
method: 提出免训练框架 FreeView，利用集合级共识选出代表性视图作为过滤参考，并针对每个输入集合融合视觉与几何证据自适应地进行视图剔除；可集成 VGGT 与 pi^3，无需人工参考或手动校准剔除阈值。
result: 在多个数据集上实现较高的干净视图保留率与干扰视图剔除率；摘要未提供具体量化数值，但实验表明可从未筛选视图中获得可靠三维重建。
conclusion: FreeView 将参考视图选择与干扰视图剔除联合起来，消除了对人工精选参考的依赖，提升了未筛选图像集合三维重建的鲁棒性与实用性。

title: GeoLift: Grounding Video Spatial Reasoning in Explicit 3D Maps
abstract: Video spatial reasoning requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to understand how objects are arranged and related across viewpoints. While these models can recognize objects in individual frames, integrating these observations to solve complex spatial tasks remains challenging. We examine route planning as a representative task and observe that existing models become substantially less accurate as the number of required turns increases, with several models achieving accuracy close to random guessing on routes requiring three or more turns. This finding suggests that recognizing landmarks alone is insufficient: models must also connect observations across viewpoints and track how landmarks are arranged in a shared space. Motivated by this observation, we introduce GeoLift, a training-free framework that uses feed-forward 3D reconstruction to map objects detected in individual frames into a shared metric 3D scene. GeoLift combines a frozen MLLM for 2D grounding with pretrained geometry models for scene reconstruction. It then uses shared geometric regions, called superpoints, to associate observations of the same object across views without a learned matcher. The reconstructed 3D map enables explicit computation of spatial relations and multistep routes, and provides geometric evidence for estimating distances and sizes. With all model weights frozen, GeoLift improves Qwen3-VL-4B's average score on VSI-Bench from 55.4% to 64.1%, including an increase in route-planning accuracy from 30.9% to 53.6%, and achieves 59.8% accuracy on MindCube. These results show that connecting frame-level object grounding through a shared 3D map can improve complex spatial reasoning without task-specific training.
tldr: GeoLift用前馈3D重建将视频帧目标统一到共享度量地图，免训练提升多步空间推理。
motivation: 现有MLLM能识别单帧物体，但难以跨视角整合观测，路线规划准确率随转弯数增加而显著下降，三步及以上路线接近随机猜测。作者指出，模型不仅需识别地标，还需在共享空间中连接跨视角观测并追踪地标布局。
method: GeoLift是免训练框架：冻结MLLM进行2D grounding，结合预训练几何模型前馈重建共享度量3D场景；利用superpoints关联跨视角同一物体观测，无需学习匹配器，并显式计算空间关系、多步路线以及距离和尺寸的几何证据。
result: 在全部模型权重冻结下，GeoLift将Qwen3-VL-4B在VSI-Bench上的平均得分从55.4%提升至64.1%，路线规划准确率从30.9%提升至53.6%，并在MindCube上达到59.8%的准确率。
conclusion: 结果表明，将帧级物体grounding通过共享3D地图连接，可在无需任务特定训练的情况下显著提升复杂空间推理能力，为视频空间推理提供了显式几何 grounding 的新路径。

title: Cross-View and Cross-Time Tracking of Crack Evolution in Concrete
abstract: Crack propagation provides richer information than static crack observations for evaluating structural conditions of concrete infrastructure and planning maintenance strategies. Unlike static crack detection, which can now be largely automated using computer vision, vision-based crack tracking is a coupled cross-view and cross-time problem: the same physical crack must retain its identity as camera viewpoints change, while newly developed growth must be distinguished from existing crack segments in a unified reference view. Existing segmentation and 3D reconstruction methods can recover crack masks or scene geometry, but they do not preserve crack identity across views or quantify temporal extension. To address this gap, this study formulates crack growth monitoring as a cross-view and cross-time crack-instance tracking task and proposes a geometry-assisted, morphology-aware framework. The framework first uses image-based geometric registration to align observations from different viewpoints into a shared structural reference, then applies morphology-aware instantiation to assign physically interpretable crack identities, and finally performs temporal mapping in the unified view to distinguish newly developed growth from existing crack segments. To enable evaluation, a temporally annotated dataset was established and used, covering three representative cracking scenarios: single dominant crack propagation, mixed-mode branching, and multiple-crack interaction, with pixel-level masks and cross-time instance labels. Experimental results show that the proposed framework can establish loose cross-view identity correspondence under changing viewpoints, while strict spatial overlap and growth localization remain limited by early micro-crack segmentability and projection drift, highlighting directions for future crack-monitoring research.
tldr: 提出几何辅助与形态感知框架，实现跨视角跨时间的混凝土裂缝实例跟踪与新增扩展判别。
motivation: 裂缝扩展比静态裂缝观测更能反映混凝土基础设施结构状况，但现有分割与三维重建方法虽能恢复裂缝掩码或场景几何，却无法在视角变化时保持同一裂缝身份，也难以量化裂缝的时间扩展。
method: 将裂缝生长监测形式化为跨视角与跨时间的裂缝实例跟踪任务，提出几何辅助、形态感知框架：先通过图像几何配准将不同视角观测对齐到统一结构参考，再利用形态感知实例化分配可物理解释的裂缝身份，最后在统一视图中进行时间映射以区分新增扩展与既有裂缝段。
result: 构建了含像素级掩码和跨时间实例标签的时间标注数据集，覆盖单主裂缝扩展、混合模式分叉和多裂缝交互三类场景；实验表明框架可在视角变化下建立松散的跨视角身份对应，但严格空间重叠和新增裂缝定位仍受早期微裂纹可分割性和投影漂移限制，摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该研究贡献了跨视角跨时间裂缝实例跟踪的任务定义、几何辅助与形态感知框架及时间标注数据集，为裂缝生长监测提供了新思路；同时揭示了微裂纹分割与投影漂移等关键瓶颈，指明后续研究方向。

title: AV-FABLE: Audio-Visual Manipulation Forensics in Long-Form Videos
abstract: Localized AI manipulations in long-form videos often affect brief events within otherwise authentic content, making video-level classification insufficient for forensic analysis. Existing audio-visual deepfake benchmarks largely focus on short talking-head clips, while long-form temporal forensics remains predominantly visual. We introduce AV-FABLE, a dual-timeline benchmark for sparse manipulations in open-scene long-form audio-visual videos. AV-FABLE contains 16,650 pristine--manipulated twin pairs (998 hours) created with 27 editing configurations, with separate audio and visual timelines that enable modality-specific temporal localization and expose errors hidden by joint-timeline evaluation. On AV-FABLE, zero-shot prompting of audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) yields near-chance detection and poor temporal localization. In contrast, supervised readouts of their frozen perception features recover strong forensic signals, suggesting manipulation evidence is encoded in these representations but not effectively exposed through language outputs. Motivated by this observation, we propose NFSR(Native Forensics via Separated Readouts), which reads frozen AV-LLM features with separate audio and visual temporal decoders. NFSR achieves the best audio-visual localization performance in-domain and across all three out-of-distribution settings, including transfer to held-out videos from an external long-video forensic benchmark. AV-FABLE, code, and model weights will be publicly released.
tldr: 提出AV-FABLE长视频视听伪造基准与NFSR方法，实现稀疏操纵的模态特定时序定位。
motivation: 现有视听deepfake基准多聚焦短视频或说话头片段，长视频时序取证仍以视觉为主，视频级分类难以定位长视频中短暂且局部的视听操纵。
method: 构建AV-FABLE双时间线基准，包含16,650对原始-篡改孪生视频（998小时、27种编辑配置），分别提供音频与视觉时间线以支持模态特定定位。基于AV-LLM零样本检测接近随机但冻结特征监督读出有效的观察，提出NFSR，用分离的音频和视觉时序解码器读取冻结AV-LLM特征。
result: AV-LLM零样本提示检测接近随机且时序定位差；NFSR在域内取得最佳视听定位性能，并在全部三种分布外设置中最佳，包括迁移至外部长视频取证基准的留出视频。
conclusion: 结果表明操纵证据已编码于冻结AV-LLM表征中，但未通过语言输出有效暴露，分离读出可释放该取证信号。作者将公开AV-FABLE、代码与模型权重，推动长视频视听操纵取证研究。

title: FlexGlue: Sparse-to-Dense Feature Matching and Visual Disambiguation
abstract: To estimate correspondences across images, existing approaches match either sparse interest points, which is highly efficient but limited by repeatability, or dense pixel grids, which is robust but expensive. Furthermore, these approaches are trained with only matching pairs and thus often fail to reject unrelated pairs that exhibit visual symmetries, which is equally important in applications like Structure-from-Motion (SfM). We bridge these gaps by introducing FlexGlue, a neural network for asymmetric sparse-to-dense matching and disambiguation. Given two images and coordinates of points in the first image, FlexGlue estimates the coordinates of the corresponding points in the second image while simultaneously rejecting the pair if non-matching. By searching for a limited set of correspondences among dense pixels, our approach is both fast and effective at both matching and disambiguation: it combines the sub-pixel accuracy of dense matching with the speed of sparse matching, while rejecting incorrect pairs with high precision. Experiments on multiple datasets show that FlexGlue pushes the Pareto frontier in relative pose estimation and significantly outperforms existing approaches for SfM and visual localization. FlexGlue is publicly available at https://github.com/cvg/flexglue .
tldr: FlexGlue实现非对称稀疏到稠密匹配与视觉消歧，兼顾速度、亚像素精度和错误配对拒绝能力。
motivation: 现有方法要么匹配稀疏兴趣点，高效但受重复性限制；要么匹配稠密像素网格，鲁棒但昂贵。此外，仅用匹配对训练的方法难以拒绝具有视觉对称性的无关图像对，而这在SfM等应用中同样关键。
method: FlexGlue输入两张图像及第一张图中的点坐标，输出第二张图中对应点坐标，并在不匹配时拒绝该点对。它通过在稠密像素中搜索有限数量的对应关系，将稠密匹配的亚像素精度与稀疏匹配的速度结合，并以高精度拒绝错误配对。
result: 在多个数据集上，FlexGlue在相对位姿估计中推进了Pareto前沿，并在SfM和视觉定位任务上显著优于现有方法；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: FlexGlue通过非对称稀疏到稠密匹配和视觉消歧，为SfM与视觉定位提供了一种快速、准确且能拒绝错误配对的解决方案，代码已开源，有望推动相关应用。

title: CompMVR: Compression-Aware Multi-View Restoration Using Diffusion Models for Geometrically Consistent 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Real-world 3D reconstruction pipelines often rely on multi-view images degraded by lossy compression. While compression artifacts have been extensively studied in single-image or video restoration, their impact on multi-view geometry remains largely overlooked. In this work, we identify compression-induced cross-view geometric inconsistency as a critical failure mode, where view-dependent artifacts disrupt feature matching, dense correspondence, camera parameter estimation, and downstream 3D reconstruction tasks such as novel view synthesis. To address this problem, we propose CompMVR, a compression-aware multi-view diffusion restoration framework that jointly refines compressed views while preserving cross-view consistency, and construct compressed datasets for systematic evaluation. Unlike conventional restoration methods that optimize each image independently for 2D perceptual quality, CompMVR leverages learned compression priors and cross-view correspondence to recover visual details while improving geometric reliability across views. Experiments across diverse datasets, codecs, and compression levels demonstrate gains in restoration quality and downstream 3D tasks, including novel-view synthesis, camera pose estimation, and view matching. These results establish compressed multi-view restoration as a distinct problem and highlight its importance for 3D reconstruction under lossy compression. Code and data for this paper are available at https://mchaewon.github.io/CompMVR-project-page/.
tldr: 提出CompMVR，利用扩散模型联合恢复压缩多视图并保持跨视角几何一致性，提升3D重建下游任务。
motivation: 真实3D重建流程中的多视图图像常受有损压缩退化，但压缩伪影对多视图几何的影响长期被忽视。作者识别出压缩导致的跨视角几何不一致是关键失效模式，会破坏特征匹配、稠密对应、相机参数估计及新视角合成等下游任务。
method: 提出CompMVR，一个压缩感知的多视图扩散恢复框架，联合精化压缩视图并保持跨视角一致性。与逐图独立优化2D感知质量的传统方法不同，它利用学习到的压缩先验和跨视角对应恢复视觉细节，同时提升跨视图几何可靠性，并构建压缩数据集进行系统评估。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标；实验在多种数据集、编解码器和压缩级别上显示，恢复质量以及新视角合成、相机位姿估计和视图匹配等下游3D任务均有提升。
conclusion: 将压缩多视图恢复确立为一个独立问题，强调有损压缩下几何一致性对3D重建的重要性，并提供代码和数据以促进后续研究。

title: VERA-Hand: A Verified Multidimensional Benchmark for 2D Hand Pose Estimation in Third-Person Dynamic Gesture Videos
abstract: Hand landmarks serve as input for gesture recognition, sign language understanding, and touchless human-computer interaction. Yet hand pose estimators are typically evaluated with frame-wise localization metrics such as PCK or MPJPE, which are computed over matched predictions and overlook missed or spurious hands, handedness errors, and temporal instability. To address these limitations, we present VERA-Hand, a benchmark that evaluates estimators using manually verified, frame-level 2D annotations for 10,690 hands across four complementary dimensions (detection, localization, identification, and temporal stability), as well as a joint Pose-F1 metric that requires both correct detection and accurate localization. Evaluating six estimators spanning hand-specific, whole-body, reconstruction-based, and foundation-model paradigms, we find that no estimator dominates: rankings reorder sharply across dimensions. VERA-Hand also exposes failures that localization-only and downstream evaluations may not reveal, including cross-hand overlap in over 85% of frames for a recent foundation model. A post-hoc cleanup case study demonstrates how the benchmark can validate corrective interventions, while stratified analyses show that robustness varies across motion-blur classes and hand regions. We release the verified annotations, protocol, and code at https://gibranbenitez.github.io/VERA_Hand/
tldr: 提出VERA-Hand多维手部姿态估计基准，覆盖检测、定位、识别与时序稳定性并揭示现有方法缺陷。
motivation: 现有手部姿态估计通常仅用PCK或MPJPE等逐帧匹配定位指标评估，忽略漏检、误检、左右手错误和时序不稳定问题。VERA-Hand旨在通过人工验证的帧级标注和多维评估协议弥补这些局限。
method: 构建包含10,690只手的人工验证帧级2D标注，从检测、定位、识别和时序稳定性四个互补维度评估估计器，并提出要求检测正确且定位准确的联合Pose-F1指标。评估覆盖手部专用、全身、重建型和基础模型四类共六种估计器。
result: 六种估计器在各维度上排名显著重排，没有单一方法全面领先；某近期基础模型在超过85%的帧中出现跨手重叠失败。事后清理案例表明该基准可验证纠正干预，分层分析显示鲁棒性随运动模糊类别和手部区域变化。
conclusion: VERA-Hand暴露了仅定位评估和下游评估可能无法发现的失败模式，并提供可验证纠正干预的基准工具。作者发布人工验证标注、评估协议和代码，推动更全面的手部姿态估计评估。

title: Guided Zero-Shot Anomaly Explanation for Anonymized Crowd Video Monitoring: Context, Categorization, and Spatial Localization
abstract: Despite the promising development of deep learning for video anomaly detection (VAD), explainability (XAI) of these models remains a challenge. Explainable and privacy-protecting VAD builds transparency and trust that facilitates adoption of computer vision systems, including safety and security monitoring. However, anomaly explainability in privacy-preserving VAD systems is underexplored. In this study, we present the XAVAD approach, a unified descriptive anomaly XAI for an anonymized VAD, that integrates flexible zero-shot anonymization, anomaly type categorization, visual localization, and scene context description. We provide empirical and qualitative assessments of multifaceted explanations integrated with full-body visual anonymization for privacy protection. We adopt a multimodal CLIP embedding for videos, using improved LLM-assisted prompting and pool-scoring mechanisms for anomaly-type identification. We enhance Grad-ECLIP for spatial anomaly heatmap localization, leveraging computation and accuracy through our novel prompt-guided patching autofocus mechanism. We employ VLMs to generate context and reasoning descriptions of detected anomalies through curated prompt engineering. We have evaluated the accuracy and computational cost of XAVAD on several publicly available CCTV and video datasets. Our experiments demonstrate substantial gains of our XAVAD over state-of-the-art benchmark approaches and provide insights into privacy protection trade-offs in XAI for VAD. We further present ablation studies and assessments across diverse configurations and modeling alternatives to demonstrate the efficacy of our proposed methods. Code: https://github.com/muleina/XAVAD}{https://github.com/muleina/XAVAD .
tldr: 提出XAVAD统一零样本异常解释框架，在匿名化人群视频中实现异常分类、空间定位与场景上下文描述。
motivation: 隐私保护视频异常检测的可解释性仍未被充分探索，现有VAD缺乏透明性与信任，且匿名化条件下难以同时完成异常类型、位置和上下文解释。
method: XAVAD集成零样本全身匿名化、基于多模态CLIP嵌入与LLM辅助提示及池化评分的异常类型识别、改进Grad-ECLIP并结合提示引导分块自动聚焦的空间热力图定位，以及利用VLM和精选提示工程生成场景上下文与推理描述。
result: 在多个公开CCTV和视频数据集上，XAVAD在准确率上显著优于现有基准，并评估了计算成本；消融实验验证了各模块及不同配置的有效性，并揭示了XAI中的隐私保护权衡。
conclusion: 该工作为匿名化VAD提供统一的可解释框架，兼顾隐私、异常分类、定位与上下文描述，提升系统透明度和可信度，并为隐私保护与解释性权衡提供实证洞察。

title: OmniRay: Camera-Agnostic Monocular 3D Reconstruction with Composite Ray Fields
abstract: Monocular models recover 3D geometry from a single image in one pass, but most assume a pinhole camera and produce distorted geometry on the wide-angle imagery produced by fisheye and panoramic lenses. Camera-aware models remove this assumption by predicting a per-pixel ray field. However, they represent different camera geometries using a single fixed basis to capture both the overall camera projection and its finer variations. We argue that camera geometry can be viewed as having a hierarchy of complexity for representing rays. We present OmniRay, a feed-forward model whose Ray Module is composed of three components: a monotone radial base that captures radially symmetric structure, a spherical-harmonic residual for smooth deviations from it, and a free-form residual for remaining local variation. These components are composed as successive rotations on the sphere, allowing the representation to accommodate diverse camera geometries. Given a single image, OmniRay predicts a ray direction and an up-to-scale radial distance for every pixel, from which a 3D point cloud is recovered without needing camera information at inference time. Extensive experiments across different camera configurations demonstrate that OmniRay establishes a new state-of-the-art in camera-agnostic monocular 3D reconstruction.
tldr: OmniRay 用复合射线场实现无需相机参数的单目宽角与全景三维重建。
motivation: 现有单目三维重建多假设针孔相机，在鱼眼和全景等宽角图像上会产生畸变几何；相机感知方法虽预测逐像素射线场，但用单一固定基同时表示整体投影与细微变化，难以适配多样相机几何。
method: 提出前馈模型 OmniRay，其 Ray Module 由单调径向基、球谐残差和自由形式残差三部分组成，并以球面上的连续旋转组合，从而分层表示相机射线几何；单图输入下预测每像素射线方向和尺度未知的径向距离，推理时无需相机信息即可恢复三维点云。
result: 摘要在不同相机配置上进行了广泛实验，表明 OmniRay 在相机无关单目三维重建中取得新的 state-of-the-art；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: OmniRay 将相机几何视为具有层次复杂度的射线表示问题，为鱼眼、全景等多样相机下的单目三维重建提供了无需相机参数的统一方案，具有较强泛化潜力。

title: HiP3R: Hierarchical Pose Graphs for Long-Horizon 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Feed-forward models accurately estimate camera motion and 3D geometry from short video windows. However, computational and memory costs prevent direct inference on sequences containing thousands of frames. Long videos must therefore be processed as overlapping chunks. This division produces independent local reconstructions with inconsistent coordinate frames and duplicate estimates of shared cameras. Achieving global consistency requires propagating constraints from adjacent overlaps and distant revisits across the sequence. This requirement naturally motivates pose graph optimization. However, the choice of graph level creates a trade-off. Chunk-level graphs efficiently resolve scale drift and close large loops. Yet, their rigid transformations cannot correct internal errors or conflicting frame predictions. Conversely, frame-level optimization offers local flexibility, but scaling it globally is computationally expensive and can break metric scale. HiP3R resolves this trade-off using a hierarchical pose graph. HiP3R first optimizes a robust chunk-level $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ graph to establish the global layout and scale. It then holds this layout fixed and estimates one shared $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ camera per frame, turning overlapping window predictions into a single trajectory. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of HiP3R in improving camera trajectories and 3D reconstruction. Our method applies to both chunk-based and streaming backends without additional training or fine-tuning. The codes are available at https://kkakkkka.github.io/HiP3R.
tldr: HiP3R 用分层位姿图先优化块级 Sim(3) 全局布局，再固定布局逐帧估计共享 SE(3) 相机，实现长视频一致的相机轨迹与三维重建。
motivation: 前馈式重建模型只能在短视频窗口上准确估计相机运动与几何，处理数千帧的长序列需切分为重叠片段分别推理，结果产生坐标系不一致、共享相机被重复估计的独立局部重建。要实现全局一致，必须把相邻重叠与远距离回访的约束传播到整条序列，而这自然归结为位姿图优化；然而块级图虽能高效消除尺度漂移和大回环，却无法修正块内误差，帧级图虽局部灵活但全局计算代价高且易破坏度量尺度。
method: HiP3R 采用分层位姿图化解上述权衡：第一阶段在块级构建鲁棒的 Sim(3) 图并优化，确立全局布局与尺度；第二阶段固定该布局，为每一帧估计一个共享的 SE(3) 相机位姿，从而把各重叠窗口的独立预测融合为单一轨迹。该方法作为后端模块可直接接入基于分块或流式的重建流程，无需额外训练或微调。
result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，HiP3R 能有效改善相机轨迹精度与三维重建质量，并可同时适配分块式与流式后端且不需重新训练；摘要未提供具体的量化指标数值。
conclusion: HiP3R 通过块级 Sim(3) 与帧级 SE(3) 的两级优化，兼顾了长序列重建的全局一致性、度量尺度保持与计算可行性。其贡献在于提供了一种无需训练、可即插即用的长时程重建后端方案，对有重叠分块推理的前馈式三维重建与 SLAM 系统具有直接的应用价值。

title: F2G-Pose: Geometry-Aware Foundation Feature Lifting for Direct RGB-D Category-Level Object Pose Estimation
abstract: This paper studies category-level RGB-D object pose estimation, which recovers an object's 3D rotation and translation without instance-specific CAD models or reference views. This task is highly ambiguous due to intra-class variations, symmetries, and partial observations. Current solutions struggle to balance reliability and efficiency: methods based on intermediate structures are prone to error propagation, while diffusion models suffer from high inference latency and complex post-hoc candidate extraction. To address this, we present F2G-Pose, a real-time direct, single-pass framework that predicts category-level pose, metric size, and camera-frame completed shape from a single RGB-D observation in one feed-forward pass. F2G-Pose lifts dense visual foundation features to partial point clouds, encodes local geometry with DGCNN tokenization, and integrates object-level structure with a Mixture-of-Experts Transformer. Joint size prediction and camera-frame shape completion encourage metric consistency through dense geometric supervision. With its task-specific network trained only on pose-annotated synthetic SOPE data and its frozen RADIO backbone externally pretrained, F2G-Pose achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on SOPE and ROPE while running at 28 FPS for pose-only inference, and further demonstrates strong camera-frame geometry on HouseCat6D and real-object transfer on HANDAL. Analyses of latency, robustness, shape completion, and GenPose++ candidate behavior further demonstrate the efficiency and reliability of F2G-Pose, with real-world manipulation experiments demonstrating deployment potential under segmented RGB-D inputs. The project page, code, and pretrained models are made available at https://jrryzh.github.io/F2G-Pose/.
tldr: F2G-Pose 以单次前向直接预测类别级 RGB-D 物体位姿、尺寸与相机系形状，兼顾精度与实时性。
motivation: 类别级 RGB-D 物体位姿估计受类内差异、对称性和部分观测影响而高度歧义。现有中间结构方法易误差传播，扩散模型推理延迟高且候选提取复杂，难以兼顾可靠性与效率。
method: F2G-Pose 将稠密视觉基础特征提升到部分点云，用 DGCNN tokenization 编码局部几何，并以 Mixture-of-Experts Transformer 整合物体级结构。框架在单次前向中联合预测位姿、度量尺寸和相机系补全形状，通过稠密几何监督增强度量一致性，且仅用带位姿标注的合成 SOPE 数据训练任务网络，冻结外部预训练的 RADIO 主干。
result: 在 SOPE 和 ROPE 上达到 state-of-the-art 精度，仅位姿推理达 28 FPS；在 HouseCat6D 展示强相机系几何，在 HANDAL 展示真实物体迁移。延迟、鲁棒性、形状补全和 GenPose++ 候选行为分析验证了效率与可靠性，真实机器人操作实验显示部署潜力。
conclusion: 该工作提出实时、直接、单次前向的类别级 RGB-D 位姿估计框架，统一位姿、尺寸与形状预测并缓解误差传播和高延迟问题。其贡献在于兼顾精度、效率与部署潜力，并公开项目页、代码和预训练模型。

title: MVLoMa: Multi-View Local Feature Matching with Any Geometry Foundation Model
abstract: Local feature matching is typically formulated for image pairs, although structure-from-motion and visual localization commonly match one reference image against many retrieved or covisible neighbours. Applying a pairwise matcher independently to these centre-neighbour edges duplicates reference-side computation and prevents the matcher from exploiting complementary multi-view geometric evidence from the remaining observations. To address these limitations, we introduce MVLoMa, a sparse star-graph matcher that extends LoMa from image pairs to multiple views. MVLoMa first uses a frozen multi-view geometry model to jointly describe all images in a star, then injects the resulting cross-view geometric context into local descriptors. It then matches the centre image to all neighbours in a single forward pass through per-view self-attention and bidirectional centre-neighbour cross-attention. For supervision, we derive positive correspondences only from depth-valid, mutually visible dense warps and explicitly penalize high-confidence matches that violate epipolar geometry. On 25-view star graphs from HyperSim, ScanNet++, Mip-NeRF 360, and Tanks and Temples, MVLoMa obtains the best macro-average relative-pose AUC among the compared methods at all three thresholds (58.65/85.41/90.99). Its matcher is 2.20 times faster than sequential evaluation of the 24 centre-neighbour edges. The same design supports four tested frozen geometry encoders -- DA3, $π^3$, VGGT, and VGGT-$Ω$ -- with DA3-Giant performing best on all reported encoder-ablation metrics. Controlled ablations further isolate the effects of geometry-aware descriptors, visibility filtering, geometric negative supervision, and joint multi-view inference.
tldr: MVLoMa将局部特征匹配从图像对扩展到星形多视图，利用冻结几何基础模型提升相对位姿估计并加速匹配。
motivation: 局部特征匹配通常按图像对独立处理，但SfM和视觉定位常需将一张参考图与多个检索或共视邻居匹配；逐边独立匹配会重复参考侧计算，且无法利用其余观测提供的互补多视图几何证据。
method: MVLoMa是一种稀疏星形图匹配器，将LoMa从图像对扩展到多视图：先用冻结的多视图几何模型联合描述星形图内所有图像，并把跨视图几何上下文注入局部描述子；再通过单次前向传播中的逐视图自注意力和双向中心-邻居交叉注意力完成中心图与所有邻居的匹配。监督方面，仅从深度有效且互相可见的稠密warp推导正对应，并显式惩罚违反对极几何的高置信匹配。
result: 在HyperSim、ScanNet++、Mip-NeRF 360和Tanks and Tuples的25视图星形图上，MVLoMa在三个阈值下均取得最佳宏平均相对位姿AUC（58.65/85.41/90.99），匹配器比顺序评估24条中心-邻居边快2.20倍。该方法支持DA3、π^3、VGGT和VGGT-Ω四种冻结几何编码器，其中DA3-Giant在所有编码器消融指标上最佳；受控消融进一步分离了几何感知描述子、可见性过滤、几何负监督和联合多视图推理的作用。
conclusion: MVLoMa将成对局部特征匹配推广到多视图星形图，在提升相对位姿估计精度的同时显著加速参考图对多邻居的匹配。其设计可兼容不同冻结几何基础模型，并通过几何感知描述子、可见性过滤、几何负监督和联合多视图推理为SfM与视觉定位提供更有效的多视图匹配方案。

title: Stream4D: Streaming 4D Reconstruction with Training-free Motion Decoupling via Causal KV-Cache Attention
abstract: 4D scene reconstruction requires robust handling of dynamic objects, yet existing streaming methods commonly assume static scenes, leading to pose drift and ghosting artifacts over long sequences. We introduce Stream4D, a training-free, motion-decoupled streaming reconstruction framework that can be directly integrated into causal Transformer backbones (e.g., StreamVGGT, Stream3R). Our key observation is that causal attention implicitly encodes rich temporal motion cues within the KV cache. We adaptively aggregate these cues from multiple attention layers and across temporal windows, and fuse them with depth priors to handle challenging cases such as occlusions and textureless regions, producing precise dynamic masks that decouple static and dynamic regions. We then apply a soft key masking scheme that leverages these dynamic masks to suppress interference from dynamic regions in causal attention, thereby improving camera pose estimation accuracy. Stream4D inherits the efficiency of causal attention and remains compatible with existing streaming architectures. On diverse dynamic-scene benchmarks, Stream4D significantly improves camera pose estimation and static-scene reconstruction quality, yields reliable dynamic masks, and effectively mitigates long-sequence ghosting.
tldr: Stream4D利用因果KV缓存中的时序运动线索实现免训练的运动解耦流式4D重建，提升位姿估计并抑制长序列鬼影。
motivation: 现有流式重建方法大多假设场景静态，在包含动态物体的长序列中会出现相机位姿漂移与鬼影伪影，而动态与静态区域的解耦通常依赖额外的训练或监督。
method: 作者发现因果注意力在KV缓存中隐含丰富的时序运动线索，于是自适应地从多个注意力层和跨时间窗口聚合这些线索，并与深度先验融合，处理遮挡与无纹理区域，生成精确的动态掩码来解耦静态与动态区域；随后采用软键掩码（soft key masking）方案，在因果注意力中抑制动态区域干扰，从而提升位姿估计精度，且可直接嵌入StreamVGGT、Stream3R等因果Transformer骨干，无需训练。
result: 在多个动态场景基准上，Stream4D显著提升了相机位姿估计与静态场景重建质量，能够输出可靠的动态掩码，并有效缓解长序列的鬼影问题；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作提出了一种免训练、可即插即用的运动解耦流式4D重建框架，继承了因果注意力的高效性并与现有流式架构兼容，为动态场景下的流式重建与位姿估计提供了新的解决思路。

title: RecallGS: Geometry-Grounded Recall for Online Semantic Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Online semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables open-vocabulary scene understanding from streaming observations. However, existing methods recover geometric context missing from image-derived semantic features using an additionally learned 3D network, incurring extra training and runtime overhead. We observe that such geometric-semantic evidence may already exist in the agent's observation history and can be retrieved rather than learned. Based on this insight, we introduce RecallGS (Geometry-Grounded Recall for Online Semantic Gaussian Splatting), a lightweight, training-free mechanism that treats past observations as a non-parametric geometric-semantic prior. RecallGS follows a recall-ground-fuse pipeline: CLIP retrieves relevant observations, alpha-compositing weights identify geometrically supported views, and aggregate their semantic features over each Gaussian's rendered footprint. On ScanNet and ScanNet++, RecallGS achieves strong semantic segmentation performance at 2.48 FPS, demonstrating that geometric-semantic context can be effectively recovered from observation history without an additional learned 3D branch.
tldr: RecallGS提出无需训练的“召回-支撑-融合”机制，从观测历史检索几何语义先验，实现在线开放词汇3D高斯语义分割。
motivation: 在线语义3DGS需从流式观测中理解开放词汇场景，但图像语义特征缺乏几何上下文；现有方法依赖额外学习的3D网络补全几何信息，带来训练与运行开销。
method: 将历史观测视为非参数化几何-语义先验，采用recall-ground-fuse流程：CLIP召回相关观测，alpha合成权重筛选几何支撑视图，并在每个高斯渲染足迹上聚合其语义特征，无需额外训练或3D分支。
result: 在ScanNet与ScanNet++上取得较强的语义分割性能，并以2.48 FPS在线运行，验证无需额外学习3D分支即可恢复几何-语义上下文。
conclusion: 表明几何-语义上下文可有效从观测历史中检索而非学习，为在线开放词汇3DGS语义理解提供轻量、免训练方案。

title: H-2DGS: Height-Field Gaussian Splatting for Sharp and Deformable Neurosurgical Surface Reconstruction
abstract: Neurosurgical navigation commonly presents magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) as 2D slices, making it difficult to relate the anatomy in those slices to the cortical surface observed through the surgical microscope. We seek a common 3D visualization that combines a photorealistic reconstruction of the exposed cortex during tumor surgery with whole-brain MRI context and diffusion tractography pathways. This requires the reconstructed cortex to form a clear boundary around the brain anatomy rather than a diffuse volume that obscures internal structures. Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) can reproduce observed views but, under limited surgical view coverage, may distribute opacity through a thick and geometrically ambiguous band. We introduce height-field 2D Gaussian Splatting (H-2DGS), a three-stage pipeline that concentrates a robust 3DGS reconstruction, fuses its depth into a shared truncated signed distance field (TSDF) surface, and represents that surface with curved, surface-oriented Gaussian primitives. Separate height, color, and opacity bases provide local geometry and appearance, while a neighbor-transition objective coordinates overlapping patches. The explicit surface further supports postoperative alignment: MRI-derived depth deforms the reconstruction, and tracked-color supervision with alternating optimization preserves its appearance. Across five real neurosurgical cases, H-2DGS gives low multi-view depth inconsistency, a compact 7.97MB representation, and interactive rendering at 29--42ms per frame. The resulting sharp, deformable surface integrates clearly with tractography and MRI anatomy, including a postoperative resection cavity.
tldr: 提出H-2DGS，将3DGS深度融合为TSDF表面并用曲面高斯表示，实现锐利可变形神经外科表面重建。
motivation: 神经外科导航中MRI二维切片难以与术中显微镜下皮层表面对应，需要同时呈现光真实感皮层、全脑MRI和弥散示踪路径的统一3D视图；但有限手术视角下传统3DGS的不透明度沿厚带分布，边界模糊并遮挡内部结构。
method: H-2DGS采用三阶段流程：先稳健重建3DGS，再将其深度融合为共享TSDF表面，最后用面向表面的曲面2D高斯基元表示该表面；高度、颜色和不透明度基分离建模局部几何与外观，邻居过渡目标协调重叠patch。术后对齐时利用MRI深度变形重建，并以跟踪颜色监督和交替优化保持外观。
result: 在5例真实神经外科病例中，H-2DGS多视角深度不一致性低，模型仅7.97MB，交互渲染每帧29–42ms；重建的锐利可变形表面可与弥散示踪、MRI解剖及术后切除腔清晰整合。
conclusion: 该方法以显式TSDF表面约束提升有限视角下神经外科皮层重建的几何锐度与可变形能力，为术中导航中融合MRI、示踪路径和真实感表面提供紧凑可交互方案。

title: Evaluation of Front-End Feature Matching for Lunar Visual SLAM
abstract: Lunar rovers will primarily rely on cameras for localization until navigation satellite services are deployed, and will continue to need them afterwards for relative navigation, hazard detection, and surface operations. Visual odometry (VO) and Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) mostly estimate motion by matching features between frames. However, feature matchers are developed on urban, indoor and driving scenes, planetary studies compare them on orbital registration or within complete SLAM systems, and real lunar imagery with reference poses is scarce, so matching between rover frames on low-texture, harshly lit terrain, and its effect on VO, has not been compared. We benchmark eleven classical and learned detector-matcher combinations on nine synthetic, lunar-testbed, and terrestrial-analogue datasets, and a feature tracker, scoring pairwise pose accuracy against baseline and the trajectory error of the resulting VO. Under a common rotation-only metric, the SuperPoint pairings outperform SIFT with ratio-tested FLANN matching on both lunar testbeds and one analogue site, with smaller or unresolved differences on synthetic data. When rotation and translation direction are scored jointly, this SIFT pairing exceeds both SuperPoint pairings on four synthetic datasets, so synthetic results alone do not establish relative performance on real rover imagery. In stereo VO, the SuperPoint pairings are not consistently more accurate than SIFT, but only they keep tracking on all eight sequential datasets. Pairings with classical detectors depend on lighting while SuperPoint changes little: a low spotlight makes them more accurate than diffuse light on the same testbed views, consistent with more contrast and detected keypoints. SuperPoint with LightGlue is the fastest learned combination (16 ms per frame), and DINOv2 retrieval proposals still need geometric verification.
tldr: 在九个月球、合成与地面数据集上评测11种特征匹配组合，SuperPoint在真实月面VO中更稳健但并非全面优于SIFT。
motivation: 月球车在无导航卫星时主要依赖相机定位，而现有特征匹配器多在城市场景开发，低纹理、强光照月面图像上的帧间匹配及其对VO的影响缺乏对比。
method: 在9个合成、月球试验场和地球类比数据集上基准测试11种经典与学习型检测器-匹配器组合及一个特征跟踪器，以相对基线的成对位姿精度和所得VO轨迹误差为指标。
result: 仅评旋转时，SuperPoint组合在两个月球试验场和一个类比站点优于采用比值检验FLANN的SIFT，合成数据差异较小或不显著；联合评旋转与平移方向时，该SIFT组合在四个合成数据集上超过两种SuperPoint组合。立体VO中SuperPoint并非始终更准，但只有其组合在全部8个序列数据集上保持跟踪；经典检测器组合受光照影响明显，聚光灯下比漫射光更准，而SuperPoint变化较小。SuperPoint+LightGlue是最快学习型组合（16 ms/帧），DINOv2检索候选仍需几何验证。
conclusion: 结果表明合成数据不足以确定真实月球车图像上的相对性能，低纹理月面VO应优先考虑SuperPoint等学习型匹配的稳健性，同时需关注评测指标与光照条件；该基准为月面视觉SLAM前端选型提供参考。

title: GSHeadRelight: Fast Relightability for 3D Gaussian Head Synthesis
abstract: Relighting and novel view synthesis of human portraits are essential in applications such as portrait photography, virtual reality (VR), and augmented reality (AR). Despite recent progress, 3D-aware portrait relighting remains challenging due to the demands for photorealistic rendering, real-time performance, and generalization to unseen subjects. Existing works either rely on supervision from limited and expensive light stage captured data or produce suboptimal results. Moreover, many works are based on generative NeRFs, which suffer from poor 3D consistency and low real-time performance. We resort to recent progress on generative 3D Gaussians and design a lighting model based on a unified neural radiance transfer representation, which responds linearly to incident light. Using only in-the-wild images, our method achieves state-of-the-art relighting results and a significantly faster rendering speed ($\times12$) compared to previous 3D-aware portrait relighting research. Project page: http://www.geometrylearning.com/GSHeadRelight/.
tldr: 基于生成式3D高斯与神经辐射传输，仅用野外图像实现快速可重光照肖像合成，渲染速度提升12倍。
motivation: 3D-aware肖像重光照需同时满足照片级真实感、实时性和对未见人物的泛化能力。现有方法依赖昂贵且有限的光场采集数据监督，或基于生成式NeRF导致3D一致性与实时性不足。
method: 采用生成式3D高斯表示，并设计基于统一神经辐射传输表示的光照模型，使其对入射光呈线性响应；仅使用in-the-wild图像训练，无需光场采集数据。
result: 在仅用野外图像训练条件下取得当前最优的重光照效果，渲染速度较此前3D-aware肖像重光照方法提升12倍。
conclusion: 提出GSHeadRelight，降低对昂贵光场数据的依赖并显著提升实时性，为VR/AR、肖像摄影等应用提供高效可重光照3D头像方案。
